notes: Scoped strictly to the Home & Decor tree (/c/home/-/N-5xtvd): Home Decor, Lighting & Ceiling Fans, the tabletop/glassware part of Kitchen & Dining, curtain rods under Window Treatments, and the decorative part of Outdoor Decor. Category tree read from the server-rendered "children" taxonomy array embedded in each Target /c/ page (direct fetch worked; PLP grids are client-rendered so no count is in the HTML). Counts come from Target's own PLP listing endpoint redsky_aggregations/v1/web/plp_search_v2 -> search_response.metadata.total_results, which is the exact number the grid pages through: verified by enumerating to exhaustion on six nodes of different sizes (Sugar Bowls 9, Taper Candles 191, Decorative Bowls 419, Wall Clocks 700, Serving Bowls 826, Semi-Flush Ceiling Lights 1170) - in every case the last tile appears at offset N-1 and offset N returns zero. Target rejects offset>1199, so nodes larger than that could not be boundary-checked and are flagged, though total_pages=ceil(total/count) held on all of them. Sponsored ad tiles are injected into the grid but are NOT in total_results (include_sponsored=false used). redsky is PerimeterX-protected from this IP after the first request, so calls were routed through the r.jina.ai reader proxy; the canonical target.com URLs are in link. Excluded per brief: scented candles (Jar/Specialty Candles - titles confirmed scented) and all home fragrance, artificial plants & flowers, wreaths & garlands, rugs, curtains/blinds, decorative pillows & blankets, wallpaper, decorative storage, furniture, bathroom, kitchen appliances/cookware/flatware/bar tools, light bulbs, ceiling fans, holiday/gift and all Shop-All/Deals/Clearance/New-Arrivals/brand landing nodes. Pillar/Taper/Votive/Tea Light/Flameless candles were kept after checking product titles - they are explicitly unscented decorative candles. RULE 0 TOP-UP (2026-08-10): re-walked the site's own children taxonomy (embedded server-rendered JSON on each /c/ category page, same technique as the original pass) for every node under Lighting & Ceiling Fans (N-5xttm) and Mirrors (N-5xtth) and diffed against what was already in this file. Found and added 16 rows the pre-Rule-0 pass had dropped: (1) the entire 'Outdoor Lighting' branch (N-5xtph, 11 leaf categories - String/Solar/Landscape & Pathway/Lanterns/Security/Ceiling/Lamps/Pendant/Post/Torches/Wall) was completely missing even though it is a same-level sibling of Ceiling Lights, Wall Lights, Lamps & Shades and Novelty Lighting; (2) 'Vanity Lights' (N-4yp2z) - this is precisely the bathroom/vanity lighting branch this company was flagged to re-check for, a sibling of Wall Sconces/Swing Arm/Picture Lights under Wall Lights; (3) 'Under-Cabinet Lighting' (N-7j5il), also under Wall Lights; (4) 'Recessed Lighting' (N-ah0pu) and 'Track Lighting' (N-4yq0e), both siblings of Chandeliers/Pendant/Flush Mount/Semi-Flush/Kitchen Island Lights under Ceiling Lights - no room word on these two, they were simply not traversed; (5) 'Bathroom Mirrors' (N-5xtv8), a sibling of Wall/Full Length & Floor/Mirror Sets/Vanity & Dresser Mirrors under the Mirrors node. All 16 qty values came from the same redsky plp_search_v2 total_results endpoint used throughout this file, reached this time via WebFetch (the r.jina.ai reader proxy was itself returning a Cloudflare interstitial for this IP at the time of this pass, and curl_cffi impersonation across 8 desktop/mobile profiles still hit the PerimeterX captcha directly against redsky.target.com) - WebFetch fetched the JSON cleanly on all 16 calls. Spot-checked for internal consistency: Outdoor Torches (qty 27) was enumerated to exhaustion (offset=27,count=1 returns zero products, confirming 27 is exact); Vanity Lights' total_pages=50 at count=24 (=1200, capped, same offset>1199 ceiling noted below) confirms it falls in the same 'cannot fully exhaust, but not five-figure/marketplace-dominated' bucket as this file's existing un-flagged four-figure rows (e.g. Chandeliers 3791, Sculptures 5225), so no MANUAL REVIEW flag was added, consistent with this file's existing convention of only flagging five-figure totals. No rows already in the file were touched, re-verified, or deleted. All product-type checks (lighting fixtures and mirrors only, no fixtures/hardware/furniture) were done directly off each node's own Target-assigned title (e.g. 'Outdoor Torches', 'Bathroom Mirrors') per Rule 0.4's product-type test.
